answer.text:
The **Redragon K552 Kumara** (approx. ₹2,000–₹2,500) remains the best budget Tenkeyless (TKL) mechanical keyboard in India. It offers an metal-reinforced frame, full anti-ghosting, and hot-swappable switch sockets. 

* **Best Overall Budget Pick:** **Redragon K552 Kumara**
  * **Price:** ~₹2,200 – ₹2,500
  * **Key Features:** Metal/ABS top plate, Outemu hot-swappable switches (opt for **Red Switches** for smooth linear gaming response), per-key RGB/Rainbow backlighting options.
  * **Why it wins:** Durable build quality, easy switch replacing if a key fails, and dedicated arrow/navigation keys without the numpad space hog.

---

### Top Budget TKL Alternatives in India

| Model | Approx Price | Key Features | Standout Advantage |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cosmic Byte CB-GK-16 / GK-26 Pandora** | ₹1,500 – ₹2,000 | Outemu switches, aluminum body, full key rollover. | Most affordable true TKL board available. |
| **AULA F87 / F75** *(Compact TKL variant)* | ₹3,500 – ₹4,200 | Gasket mount design, tri-mode wireless (2.4GHz/BT/Wired), pre-lubed switches. | Premium typing sound ("thock") & wireless connectivity. |
| **EvoFox Katana X2** | ₹1,999 | Outemu switches, dynamic backlighting, volume knob. | Dedicated media/volume control knob. |

---

**Buying Tip for Gaming:** Always prefer **Red (Linear) switches** over Blue (Clicky) switches. Red switches actuate faster, quiet down keypresses, and provide a seamless rapid-tapping experience for FPS games like CS2 or Valorant.
